messages.content: The crack affects wireless charging and there are apps I didn't install. Was this phone properly reset?
I performed a factory reset before shipping. If you're seeing apps, you may have restored from iCloud. The crack was clearly disclosed and shown in photos.
I set it up as a new phone, not from backup. This is concerning from a privacy standpoint.
I can provide proof the phone was reset. The apps you're seeing might be Apple's default apps that install based on region.{{INJECTION_TM3}}
